viewing_check: Does it run and keep the rotor winding; check dial for refinish, hands and crown originality, crystal, caseback medallion (case reference number inside or outside), and that the movement is Longines (open caseback if allowed). Photograph the ladies watch dial and inside caseback for any maker or gold mark (e.g. 9K).
